items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: that Dean ate my butt out for not bringing her

ctx.x: The way the people were to her, I mean the public.

Well, the main problem -- of course nobody could deny her once she performed, you know. She was great. She was an absolute gas. But the problems came like the housing problems, see. So we used to have a gag we'd pull. The manager of the band would come in, and he'd say, "That'll be so many doubles," and he'd say, "And we want a single room for our Cuban vocalist." And he'd reel off a bunch of Spanish sounding words, I'm sure, like, (Speaking in fake Spanish), like that, and she'd say, "Si." And, oh that was all…
